title: ERSTE002
ERSTE002
body: 右手非对称外形把键盖的高度差延续到掌心区域。下方采用开放式结构，省去传统底壳。
An asymmetric right-hand profile carries the change in button height into the palm area. An open underside replaces the conventional bottom shell.

title: 食指高，中指低
Index higher, middle lower
body: 以右手握持方向为准，左键的食指支撑面高于右键的中指支撑面。两个标记取自相同前后位置的模型表面。
In the right-hand grip, the left button supports the index finger above the right button's middle-finger surface. The markers sample both surfaces at the same depth.

title: 倾斜延伸到上盖
The slope continues into the shell
body: 键盖的左右高度差延续到上盖肩部。高侧保持隆起，低侧更早收向侧壁，形成连续的横向倾斜。
The height difference continues from the buttons into the shell shoulders. The high side stays raised while the low side turns into the sidewall sooner, continuing the crosswise slope.

title: 掌心支撑与手腕方向
Palm support and wrist angle
body: 上盖后部延续左高右低的曲面。掌心支撑面顺着这道横向斜度布置，以配合右手握持时的手腕倾斜。
The rear shell carries the higher left side and lower right side into the palm area. The crosswise slope is designed to accommodate the wrist angle of a right-hand grip.

title: 开放式底部
Open underside
body: 外壳下方省去传统底壳。开放区域露出侧壁、内部横撑和电子件的布置位置。
The design omits the conventional bottom shell. The open area exposes the sidewalls, cross-bracing and the space for the electronics.

title: 五组部件的装配关系
Five groups in assembly
body: 滚轮与键盖位于上盖上方，主板与电池布置在下方。电子件为装配示意，用于交代它们与外壳的相对位置。
The wheel and button covers sit above the upper shell, with the board and battery below. The electronics are assembly references showing their positions relative to the shell.

title: 侧切上盖
Lateral shell section
body: 剖面穿过上盖侧壁和内部加强结构。实心截面显示薄壁与筋板的材料分布，空腔保持开放。
The section crosses the sidewall and internal reinforcement. Solid cut faces show where the thin walls and ribs carry material, while cavities remain open.

title: 类工字形截面
I-like rib section
body: 上盖截边与加强筋下缘构成两道边缘，中间由肋腹连接。类工字形截面把材料分布在上下缘及其连接处。
The shell edge and lower rib edge form two flanges linked by a web. This I-like section places material along both edges and the web that joins them.

title: 加强筋、侧壁与横撑
Ribs, sidewalls and cross-bracing
body: 弧形筋板沿上盖内面延伸并接入侧壁。横向撑杆跨过开放底部，将两侧结构连在一起。
Curved ribs follow the inner shell and join its sidewalls. Transverse braces span the open underside and connect the two sides.

title: 按键盖内侧加强筋
Ribs beneath the buttons
body: 两片薄壁键盖各有交叉筋。筋条沿键面内侧延伸并接入边缘，在薄壁下方形成局部支撑。
Each thin-walled button cover has crossing ribs. The ribs run along the underside and meet the edges, providing local support beneath the button surface.

title: ERSTE002
ERSTE002
body: 右手非对称外形、开放式底部与一体式加强结构构成整机方案。约 33 g 为设计目标。
The complete design combines a right-hand asymmetric profile, an open underside and integrated reinforcement. Approximately 33 g is the design target.
